text: D215445 explicitly requested complete sentence comments, and the author updated the patch before acceptance. Use this as manual review guidance for comments that explain behavior, including tests. Formatter and valid-jsdoc syntax do not establish the completeness or meaning of the sentence. Preserve exact identifiers in those sentences. Existing terse comments are not evidence to require a broad untouched-code rewrite.
title: Write new and changed comments as complete sentences
